description.value:
“The first thing worth defending was the circle of people who decided, against all sense, to keep each other warm through the night.”

First Fire (1/a Soma Break). You can spend 10 minutes building a coalition fire — a real one, not a metaphor. While the fire burns and creatures shelter within 30 feet of it (up to 1 hour, or longer if you tend it):

  • Friendly creatures have reroll the lowest die on defense checks [TODO(adv-call)] against being Shaken or exhausted.
  • Friendly creatures regain 1 extra Integrity per Hit Die spent during a Soma Break taken at the fire.
  • The first time any hostile creature crosses within 30 feet of the fire, every friendly creature there knows it.

The fire counts as a defensible camp for narrative purposes — a place that NPCs will hesitate to violate without cause.
